A high-scoring thriller in the Abu Dhabi T10 League!
Yas Lions chased down 116 against Emirates Eagles to seal a thrilling six-wicket victory, getting over the line with eight balls to spare!
Dasun Shanaka led the charge with a sensational 60 off just 25 balls, while Shimron Hetmyer smashed 65 for the Emirates Eagles earlier in the contest.
